# The unit job's CI reporter names no passing tests

## Context

The defect ledger's machine producer (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#321, Brain PR #327) recovers a red record only when a newer green run of the record's own job **names the test with a pass mark in its log** — the `list` reporter's `✓ N [project] › path:line:col › titles (duration)` line. That rule is round 2 of @neo-gpt's review: a job's colour, or the spec file's presence at the green head, proved nothing about one test; his control recovered a record whose test no longer existed.

The `components` job satisfies the rule today: `test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs:21` sets `reporter: [['list']]`. The `unit` job cannot: `test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs:16-27` `buildUnitRunPolicy({isCI})` sets `[['github'], ['json', {outputFile: 'test-results/unit/test-results.json'}]]` in CI. The `github` reporter prints one dot per passing test (`···×··×···`) and `::error` annotations only for failures, and the JSON report — which does carry per-test results — reaches nobody on a green run, because `.github/workflows/test.yml:361-366` uploads `test-results/` only `if: failure()`. Measured on the unit job's log of run 33887831112 (the fixture in the Brain's `CiFailureIngestor.spec.mjs`): passing tests are dots, failing ones are annotations plus numbered blocks; the summary line `3158 passed` names none of them.

**Consequence:** every unit-suite record the producer files — the class of #17796 ("one arbitrary test per run"), #18215 ("one run in eight"), #18275, #18290 — stays red until a human recovers it by hand. The ledger measures unit flakes and can never see one end. The producer reports this as `no-per-test-evidence` and leaves the record red; PR #327's AC-4 states the bound and names this ticket as the way to lift it.

## The Problem

Two per-test signals exist in a unit run and neither reaches a reader on a green run: the `github` reporter's dots carry no names, and the JSON report is an artifact only when the job failed. Recovery needs a positive observation about *this* test in a job that ran after the sighting; a summary count is not one.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs:16-27` — `buildUnitRunPolicy({isCI})`: `reporter = [['json', …]]`, then `isCI && reporter.unshift(['github'])`; also `failOnFlakyTests: isCI`, `forbidOnly: isCI`, `retries: isCI ? 2 : 0`, `workers: isCI ? 4 : undefined`. No spec pins the policy today (the only references are the config's own).
- `test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs:21` — `reporter: [['list']]`, the precedent whose log the producer already reads (240 `✓` lines per run).
- `.github/workflows/test.yml:355-366` — `Run ${{ matrix.suite }} tests` via `npm run test-${{ matrix.suite }}`; artifacts uploaded only on failure — right for cost, and not what this ticket changes.
- Brain `ai/services/ingestion/CiFailureIngestor.mjs` `parsePlaywrightPasses` (PR #327) — the consumer: it strips the duration and `(retry #n)` suffixes, keys the pass by `<spec path> › <title path>`, ignores `-` (skipped) and `✘` (failed) lines, and yields an empty set for a dot log.
- Playwright reporters compose: `[['github'], ['list'], ['json', …]]` prints the annotations, one line per test, and the file.

## The Fix

In `buildUnitRunPolicy`, add `['list']` to the CI reporter list beside `['github']` — `[['github'], ['list'], ['json', {outputFile}]]` — and leave the local (`isCI: false`) list unchanged. Pin the policy with a unit spec importing `buildUnitRunPolicy` from the config module (structural pre-flight fast-path: the tooling specs under `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/` are the sibling pattern; place by that gate). The `github` annotations and the JSON report stay; the failure-only upload stays.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `buildUnitRunPolicy({isCI: true}).reporter` (`test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs:16`) | this ticket; `playwright.config.component.mjs:21` as the precedent | `[['github'], ['list'], ['json', {outputFile}]]` — annotations, one line per test, the report | local (`isCI: false`) unchanged: `json` only | the function's JSDoc | the pinning spec; one green `unit` job log on dev showing `✓ N [unit-engine] › …` lines |
| the `unit` job's CI log | GitHub Actions | ~3,300 more lines per run, one per test — the `components` job already carries 240 | — | — | log size of one run before and after, in the PR body |

## Decision Record impact

`none` — a test-tooling policy change; no ADR authority is touched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 — In CI (`isCI: true`) the unit run policy's reporter list is `github`, `list`, `json` in that order; locally (`isCI: false`) it is unchanged. A unit spec pins both.
- [ ] AC-2 — A green `unit` job's log on dev names every passing test as `✓ N [unit-engine] › <spec>:<line>:<col> › <titles> (<duration>)`; one run's log is cited in the PR body, with its size against a run before the change.
- [ ] AC-3 — The `github` annotations for failures and the JSON report are still produced; the failure-only artifact upload is untouched.
- [ ] AC-4 — Post-merge, owned by the Brain producer's tick rather than this PR: the ledger recovers a unit-suite record from a green unit run (the `[recovered]` note names that run). Reported on this ticket when the first one lands.

## Out of Scope

- Uploading `test-results/` on green runs — artifact volume on every run, and the consumer would need a download and an unzip per run where a log read already exists.
- The `components` job (already `list`) and the e2e configs.
- Any change to the Brain producer.
- Local reporter behaviour.

## Avoided Traps

- **Replacing `github` with `list`.** The inline PR annotations are what reviewers read on a red run; the reporters compose, so neither has to go.
- **Parsing the dot progress line.** Dots carry no names — there is nothing to attribute.
- **Treating `N passed` as evidence.** A count is not an observation about one test; that is the exact error round 1 of PR #327 made with job colour.
